# revenue_contract_admission

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Produces the terminal immutable admission receipt binding a qualified opportunity to an executable paid revenue contract.

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |

| `opportunity_id` | `string` | yes | Required revenue contract admission input; omission is an executable typed refusal, never an inferred approval. |

| `admission_receipt_hash` | `string` | yes | Immutable decision or evidence identity used to verify and replay this bounded commercial admission. |
